args: {"summary": "The resclust CLI hardcoded the scipy `fcluster` criterion to \"distance\", so the threshold could only be used as a distance cutoff. I added a `criterion` parameter to `cluster_similarity_matrix` in `src/arctic3d/modules/clustering.py` (defaulting to \"distance\" so existing behavior and callers are unchanged) and passed it through to `fcluster`. In `src/arctic3d/cli_resclust.py` I added a `--criterion` argument with choices `distance`/`maxclust` (default `distance`), threaded it into `main` and the clustering call, and documented it in the module docstring. This lets users run e.g. `arctic3d_resclust pdb --residue_list ... --criterion maxclust --threshold 3` to split the residues into at most n clusters. All existing tests pass."}
